description: Virtualization and local Kubernetes runtime caches/logs on macOS beyond Docker Desktop and Colima already covered elsewhere. path_count counts distinct path templates across rules. Disk images (.qcow2, .raw, .vdi, .vmdk, .pvm, .vmwarevm, .utm bundles, Lima/OrbStack/Multipass instance disks) are report-only or excluded from default clean. Prefer native prune commands where noted.
never_touch_notes: Never delete Parallels .pvm, VMware .vmwarevm, UTM .utm bundles, Tart ~/.tart/vms as default clean
Never wipe OrbStack Group Containers data img / disk.img as default
Never wipe Lima ~/.lima/<instance>/disk or _disk/datadisk as default
Never wipe Multipass instance vaults under multipassd data as default
Never wipe Vagrant boxes (~/.vagrant.d/boxes) as default clean (report-only)
Docker Desktop raw/qcow2 and Colima default instance remain covered by earlier batches; this batch does not re-enable their deletion

rules.name: VirtualBox host logs and app caches
rules.description: VirtualBox service/selector logs and macOS app caches. Regenerable; close VirtualBox first.
rules.notes: Target logs/caches only under Library/VirtualBox; leave VirtualBox.xml and machine registry if present. Prefer VBoxManage for diagnostics.

rules.name: VirtualBox VMs and hard disks (report-only)
rules.description: Default VM folder and HardDisks registry; report size only, never default wipe.
rules.notes: Contains .vdi/.vmdk and machine folders. User must remove VMs via VirtualBox UI/VBoxManage.

rules.name: VMware Fusion caches and logs
rules.description: Fusion app caches, ShipIt update cache, host logs, Applications Menu cache, license backups.
rules.notes: Not .vmwarevm bundles. Applications Menu rebuilds on next guest launch.

rules.name: VMware Fusion VM locations (report-only)
rules.description: Common default/custom locations for .vmwarevm packages; inventory only.
rules.notes: Actual VM path is user-chosen; these are common defaults only.

rules.name: Parallels Desktop caches and logs (deeper)
rules.description: Parallels host caches, ShipIt, software caches, application menus, logs. Not .pvm VMs.
rules.notes: Never delete Documents/Parallels or $HOME/Parallels .pvm bundles.

rules.name: Parallels VM directories (report-only)
rules.description: Default Parallels VM store locations; report only.
rules.notes: .pvm packages hold entire VMs; remove only via Parallels Control Center.

rules.name: UTM caches and logs (not VM images)
rules.description: UTM app caches including downloaded IPSW restore images under container Caches, plus logs.
rules.notes: IPSW under container Caches is large and regenerable. Do not delete Data/Documents/*.utm.

rules.name: UTM VM documents (report-only)
rules.description: Sandboxed UTM Documents tree with .utm VM packages; report only.
rules.notes: Contains .utm bundles with disk images. Never default clean.

rules.name: QEMU host caches
rules.description: User-level QEMU cache directories when present (Homebrew/standalone). Not guest disk files.
rules.notes: Never target arbitrary .qcow2/.raw elsewhere as default. Firmware is usually under Cellar/share, not cleaned here.

rules.name: Common QEMU disk image locations (report-only)
rules.description: Inventory-only common user folders that may hold qcow2/raw; never default wipe extensions.
rules.notes: Explicit policy: never wipe .qcow2/.raw as default clean path.

rules.name: Multipass image and network caches
rules.description: Multipass download/network caches. On macOS daemon often stores under root Library; user-level caches if present.
rules.notes: Root-owned paths need elevated scan/delete. Prefer multipass delete --purge and multipass purge for instances. network-cache under multipassd is regenerable.

rules.name: Multipass instance data (report-only)
rules.description: Multipass vault/instance disks under multipassd data; report only.
rules.notes: Instance disks live under multipassd data vaults. Use multipass delete --purge, not bulk rm.

rules.name: Lima download cache (not instances)
rules.description: Standalone Lima image download cache at Library/Caches/lima. Safe to clear; re-downloads on next limactl start.
rules.notes: Hard-coded ~/Library/Caches/lima on macOS per Lima docs. Does not remove ~/.lima instances.

rules.name: Lima instance serial and hostagent logs
rules.description: Aged serial/hostagent logs inside ~/.lima instances without touching disk images.
rules.notes: Exclude disk, basedisk, diffdisk, datadisk, *.qcow2, *.raw. Stop instances first (limactl stop).

rules.name: Lima instances and additional disks (report-only)
rules.description: Full Lima home including instance disks and _disk datadisks; report only.
rules.notes: disk/diffdisk/basedisk and _disk/datadisk are VM storage. Use limactl delete. Never default-wipe qcow2/raw.

rules.name: OrbStack logs and app caches
rules.description: OrbStack host logs under ~/.orbstack/log and standard macOS app cache/log locations. Not data disks.
rules.notes: Leave ~/.orbstack/vmconfig and Group Containers data alone for clean; disks are report-only.

rules.name: OrbStack data and disks (report-only)
rules.description: OrbStack VM/container data store including large data.img; report only.
rules.notes: Default data is Group Containers HUAQ24HBR6.dev.orbstack/data (often multi-GB sparse image). Prefer OrbStack UI prune; ~/OrbStack is a mount view not storage.

rules.name: Rancher Desktop caches and logs
rules.description: K3s image cache and Rancher Desktop logs. Factory reset keeps cache unless --cache; this targets caches/logs only.
rules.notes: rdctl reset --factory --cache is native alternative. Do not delete Application Support lima VM disk here.

rules.name: Rancher Desktop data and Lima VM (report-only)
rules.description: Rancher Desktop application support, snapshots, and lima-backed VM state; report only.
rules.notes: Includes lima instance disks and snapshots. Use rdctl reset --factory for supported wipe.

rules.name: Podman Desktop Electron caches and logs
rules.description: Podman Desktop GUI logs and Chromium-style caches under Application Support. Not podman machine disks.
rules.notes: Logs under Library/Logs/Podman Desktop can grow large (plist append issue fixed in newer releases).

rules.name: Podman machine and container storage (report-only)
rules.description: Podman machine images, storage, and container graph under home; report only.
rules.notes: Prefer podman system prune / podman machine rm. Never default-delete machine qcow2/raw.

rules.name: minikube cache and logs (deeper)
rules.description: minikube ISO/image/preload caches and logs. Machines stay report-only elsewhere.
rules.notes: minikube cache delete / minikube delete --all --purge for native cleanup. Regenerates on next start.

rules.name: minikube machines and profiles (report-only)
rules.description: minikube VM disks and profile state; report only.
rules.notes: Use minikube delete. Disk drivers may store large files under machines/.

rules.name: kind cluster state
rules.description: kind local cluster metadata under ~/.kind. Node images live in container runtime.
rules.notes: Prefer kind delete cluster --all. Docker/Podman images for kindest/node remain in the runtime until pruned.

rules.name: k3d state and caches
rules.description: k3d config/state directories when present. Clusters are Docker containers; host metadata only here.
rules.notes: Prefer k3d cluster delete --all. Images remain in Docker until docker/podman prune.

rules.name: Vagrant tmp and logs
rules.description: Vagrant temporary downloads and logs under ~/.vagrant.d. Not boxes.
rules.notes: Boxes stay report-only. Incomplete box downloads often sit in tmp.

rules.name: Vagrant boxes (report-only)
rules.description: Downloaded Vagrant boxes under ~/.vagrant.d/boxes; large and user-managed.
rules.notes: Use vagrant box remove / vagrant box prune. Never default-wipe boxes.

rules.name: Packer ISO and plugin caches
rules.description: Common PACKER_CACHE_DIR locations and plugin dir. Default packer_cache is cwd-relative and not listed.
rules.notes: ISOs in cache are large and regenerable. Plugins re-download on next packer init. Set PACKER_CACHE_DIR for a stable shared cache.

rules.name: Tart OCI and IPSW cache
rules.description: Tart remote image cache under ~/.tart/cache (OCIs, IPSWs). VMs under vms/ stay report-only.
rules.notes: tart pull/clone auto-prunes when free space is low. TART_HOME defaults to ~/.tart.

rules.name: Tart local VMs (report-only)
rules.description: Local Tart VM images under ~/.tart/vms; report only.
rules.notes: Use tart delete. Disk images for running CI/macOS guests live here.

rules.name: kubectl and related client caches
rules.description: Client-side kubectl discovery/HTTP caches often used with local virt k8s stacks.
rules.notes: Does not touch kubeconfig. Safe regenerable client metadata.

rules.name: Helm chart cache
rules.description: Helm repository and chart cache commonly paired with local k8s (kind/k3d/minikube/Rancher).
rules.notes: helm repo update re-fetches indexes. Not kubeconfig.
